name: BirdVox-full-night: Bird Flight Call Audio Detection Benchmark
description: BirdVox-full-night contains 6 full-night audio recordings (over 62 continuous hours) of nocturnal avian flight calls captured by autonomous bioacoustic monitoring sensors in upstate New York during the autumn 2015 bird migration season, annotated with exact avian flight call timestamp stamps.

publisher.name: New York University / Cornell Lab of Ornithology

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: Dataset released on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0.

source_references.title: BirdVox Project Portal
source_references.notes: New York University BirdVox project homepage.

source_references.title: Acoustic Detection of Flight Calls for Bird Migration Monitoring Using Deep Learning

verification.notes: Verified against ICASSP 2018 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICASSP.2018.8461323) and Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.1205561).

size.notes: Six multi-gigabyte continuous uncompressed 44.1kHz FLAC/WAV audio files and CSV call annotations.
